Full text: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/
Source of the font files: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Ubuntu+Sans (Google Fonts).

NOTE: the full licence text could not be downloaded in this build (the Google Fonts
repository path returned 404 and no other download was allowed), so this file only
names the licence and its official address. Replace it with the full OFL.txt of the
Ubuntu Sans project before the repository is made public.
